subject: MSA / Order Form — output entitlements & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novus.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MSA / Order Form — output entitlements & evidence handoff

Hi Samira —

Thanks for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion we want to close the remaining MSA + Order Form items so Novus can move to procurement next week. Two items we still need to align on: output entitlement language and the evidence we require to honor a training opt-out on Exhibit A.

Summary of Redwood position (high level):
- Output ownership: customer retains ownership of "Customer Outputs" generated from their prompts/inputs.
- Feedback license: Redwood requests a narrow, nonexclusive feedback license limited to de-identified, aggregated signals used solely to improve model serving and performance (no customer-attributed training).
- Training opt-out: if Novus elects the opt-out checkbox in Exhibit A, Redwood will not include Novus prompt/response pairs in model training streams. To operationalize that opt-out, our procurement team requires a brief evidence handoff (see below).

I've attached a redlined Order Form (redlined-orderform.docx) and a draft Exhibit A (Novus_ExhibitA_v3.pdf) that adds the opt-out checkbox and the evidence acceptance criteria. For clarity, our minimal evidence request to complete procurement is:
1) a 72-hour telemetry sample export (anonymized IDs + timestamp + request/response token counts + flag indicating opt-out) — example file: evidence-telemetry-sample.csv
2) confirmation of SOC 2 control 6.2 (or equivalent) covering telemetry retention and access controls (we accept a PDF excerpt or link)
3) an authorized signoff on Exhibit A (checkbox + signature)

Ask: can your legal/procurement team review the redline and confirm the exact telemetry fields Novus can provide? If they can produce the sample and the SOC2 excerpt we can route to Procurement and finalize billing/activation.

Target: get Novus confirmation by EOD Thursday 2026-11-19 so we can close in this procurement window. If there are specific language requests from Legal Ops, flag them inline in the redline and we'll respond.

Thanks —

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: redlined-orderform.docx, Novus_ExhibitA_v3.pdf

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novus.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <contracts@novus.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@novus.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — output entitlements & evidence handoff

Jordan —

Thanks for the note and the redline. We appreciate Redwood's clarity. A couple of quick clarifying questions from Legal Ops before we commit to generating the telemetry sample:

1) "Anonymized IDs" — do you require a mapping table (hashed IDs) or can you accept strictly non-reversible session identifiers? We prefer non-reversible session IDs and would like to avoid any requirement to provide a mapping.
2) "Flag indicating opt-out" — we can include a boolean field per request, but we need to confirm the retention window Redwood needs to validate the opt-out. Are you asking for the most recent 72 hours prior to contract signature, or ongoing periodic exports?
3) "Feedback license" — please confirm whether the license Redwood requests permits using aggregated signals for model improvement only in the hosted Redwood fleet, or also in non-hosted variants (we need to understand cross-deployment usage).

Procurement timeline: we have a procurement gate on 11/24. If we can get explicit field-level requirements by 11/19, Legal Ops will generate the sample and SOC2 snippet during the week of 11/22.

I've attached Novus_feedback_requirements.docx which lists our internal constraints. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call with Laura/Neha if that helps.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Legal Ops
Novus AI
samira.khan@novus.ai

Attachments: Novus_feedback_requirements.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novus.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — output entitlements & evidence handoff

Samira / Novus team —

Appreciate the fast reply. To reduce back-and-forth, here's the exact checklist Redwood needs to (a) accept the Exhibit A opt-out and (b) clear procurement: 

Redwood Evidence Acceptance Checklist (minimal):
A. Exhibit A: signed page with the opt-out checkbox and signatory name + date (PDF)
B. Telemetry sample (CSV) — fields: non-reversible_session_id, utc_timestamp, request_token_count, response_token_count, opt_out_flag (boolean), api_route. We do not need customer-identifying PII or a mapping table. Non-reversible_session_id satisfies our operational needs.
C. Retention confirmation: statement (or SOC2 excerpt) that telemetry for opt-out evaluation is retained for at least 30 days and access is limited to named personnel. A SOC2 control excerpt or an attestation from your security team is acceptable.
D. Feedback license language: Redwood will add clarifying text to the Order Form that feedback is only used in aggregate, de-identified form and not for customer-attributed training. If Novus requires stricter language (e.g., only used for runtime improvements, not model parameter updates), please propose text in-line and we will review.

Operational notes:
- The CSV sample can be sanitized and S3-shared or delivered via a secure Box link.
- We will accept the telemetry sample for validation only — it will not be stored beyond the procurement review unless Novus signs Exhibit A.

Next steps: If Novus can confirm the CSV fields above and provide SOC2 excerpt by 11/19 EOD we will route the redline + evidence package to Procurement for final signoff on 11/22. If you prefer a short alignment call, Laura and Neha are available tomorrow 11/19 between 9–12 PT.

Thanks —

Laura Bennett
Director, Deals & Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: evidence-checklist.pdf

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — output entitlements & evidence handoff

Ack — I'll own the telemetry sample prep.

Action items for infra/security (Ben):
- Prepare a 72-hour export with the exact fields Laura listed. We will salt the session ID server-side to ensure non-reversibility and remove any PII.
- Generate a short attestation from Security re: telemetry retention and access controls (will include relevant SOC2 excerpt if available).

Jordan: confirming we can deliver the CSV to a secure Box link by EOD 11/20. Once delivered, Jordan, can you confirm whether Novus needs us to mask api_route values or if the literal route names are OK?

Samira: if you can confirm that route names are fine, we will proceed. Otherwise call out the allowed masking and we will apply it.

Ben Carter
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
